notes: Players roleplay as the horses, piglets, cats, dogs and quokkas and wander, which is Roleplay & Avatar Sim's Animal Sim rather than any of the town presets — an animal sim has no settlement, so the shape is wilderness-open and the housing question never arises. The answer pins the scale at one cozy glade around the lake, so it is a single continuous surface with no biome split and no P4. The lake is named outright, so it is carried as water-body with the prompt's magical forest wording; that adds a CHECK which should pass, since a lake in a glade does not self-occlude. Deciding without a user: kept the preset's shared gathering clearing and a focal landmark for orientation, dens as open shelters any animal can use rather than personal property, and no terminus at all because wandering is the whole game.
